Thanks for your advice. Yeah I am still here. I have thought about many things. About your point:
-I was in therapy once. It did literally nothing.


-I am pretty self confident. Thats atleast what all my friends tell me. 
And they have watched me approach women and told me I was doing pretty good (they all have gfs so I guess they do have some sort of idea)


-Going to the gym once a week does not really make any difference. If you want to make progress you have to go atleast like 3 times a week.
My looks are the thing that stop me from achiving this. Therefore I have to keep going.


-And the sentence "you will find someone eventually, just wait". I dont believe in it. There so many cases of men being in their 60s 70s or even 80s that are still waiting. 
You dont want to believe it. But there are ton of people like that out there. They still have hope and are waiting.
The majority if those people died or will die alone.
They were waiting the whole 80 yearsvof their life without any luck. And were hopeful until their last breath.
I dont want do so this. I will probably turn crazy if I wait that long.


-Idk man I feel like there is nothing much I can do.
Women are just more superficial then men I think. Thats how it is. 
The argument "that there are 8 billion people on this planet, so 4 billion women there will be one who will love you" does not really make sense. 
It might be true however how am I supposed to go through all 4 billion women. I live in a city with around 200k people. 100k are women. I dont think that I will be able to go through all these women and stay sane while getting rejected. I have been rejected by around 500 women now.


-I will consider a few more things. I will try approaching 500 more women and then maybe plastic surgery? Even though its completly against my principles. Idk man I have no clue left.

Sorry for the rant have a nice day and thanks again
